methods.label: Compare the magnitudes
methods.explanation: Their magnitudes are 1 and 2, respectively, so \(|b|\) is 2 times \(|a|\). The two vectors have the same direction but different magnitudes, so they are not equal.
methods.levelReason: Uses the lengths of vectors along a coordinate axis and an elementary multiplicative comparison.
